title: Type - Vesting Period in Months
description: Describes a period of time expressed in months (e.g. 3 months) for use in Vesting Terms.

length.description: The quantity of `type` units of time; e.g. for 3 months, this would be `3`; for 30 days, this would be `30`

occurrences.description: The number of times this vesting period triggers. If vesting occurs monthly for 36 months, for example, this would be `36`

cliff_installment.description: If specified, the 1-indexed vesting installment at which the cliff condition occurs. If this field is not provided or less than 2, it is treated as as if no cliff applies.

day_of_month.description: The calendar day of a month to award vesting.
